Equivalence iff fully faithful and essentially surjective

The criterion combines complete control of arrows between image objects with enough objects up to isomorphism.

Story / Fairy Tale · 3.7

Story analogy

This story is an analogy, not the mathematical statement or proof.

Fern's translation accounts uniquely for every permit between image towns, and every target town has an isomorphic representative. Mira chooses those representatives and uses the unique permit preimages to build a return translator.

Story key
Unique permit preimages
Fullness and faithfulness
Chosen town representatives
Essential surjectivity with choices used to construct a quasi-inverse
